_comment: AA-935 (CRM-07): the e2e test users of the synthetic AA-Partner agencies on Dev. One source for e2e_mailbox.tf (receipt-rule recipients) and tools/identity/crm_dev_identity.py; the agency keys and roles match AA-Partner api/app/seed/catalogue.py. Usernames e2e-test-crm-<agency>-<role>, mail e2e-test-crm-<agency>-<role>@e2e-mail.<zone>. AA-939: an entry with "invitee": true is a mailbox recipient for the timed invitation E2E only (never created by e2e-users; invitee-reset deletes its partner-pool account).
_comment_studio: AA-979 (S252, root ADR 0006a A10b-1): the Content studio invitees of the phase 2 re-enrolment E2E (a CIS tenant, not a CRM agency). Mail e2e-test-studio-<role>@e2e-mail.<zone>, role = the Content studio role the invitation grants (viewer / editor). Mailbox recipients only: never created by e2e-users; invitee-reset --invitee studio-<role> deletes the partner-pool account.
